items.text: The Brightpath youth program pairs students with trained adult mentors for weekly after-school sessions. 340 students took part in the 2025-26 school year, as reported by the program office.
items.source: Brightpath Youth Alliance program office, 2025-26 enrollment report

items.text: Gifts to the Spring Youth Appeal fund mentor training, session materials, and transport to sessions, as listed in the approved 2026 program budget.
The youth program runs a free two-week summer day camp. 85 students attended in summer 2026, as reported by the camp director.
items.source: Brightpath Youth Alliance summer camp report 2026
